name: Hagabadet
tagline: Classic bath and spa in Haga with a Roman-Irish bath.
description: Hagabadet in Gothenburg is a beautiful bath and spa house dating back to 1876, known for its Roman-Irish bath and its saunas. A calm oasis for bathing, sauna and treatments in the heart of the Haga district. Book a day spa online and choose your venue.
instructions: Book a day spa online and choose your venue (Haga, Drottningtorget or Älvstranden).
A minimum age of 16 applies to all services.
Bathrobe and towel hire are included in the day spa entry.

name: Saltholmens Kallbadhus
tagline: Seaside sauna and cold bath at the tip of Saltholmen in the Gothenburg archipelago.
description: At the very end of Saltholmen, where the tram stops and the archipelago boats depart, sits an atmospheric cold bath house with a sauna and direct access to the sea. A favourite among Gothenburgers who like to alternate between sauna heat and a refreshing dip in the West Sea.
instructions: Drop-in with a cash or Swish fee - check current times on site.
Bring a towel; simple changing and shower facilities are available on site.
Cold bathing directly in the sea year-round.

name: Ribersborgs Kallbadhus
tagline: Historic cold bath house from 1898 out in the Öresund with a wood-fired sauna.
description: One of Sweden's best-loved cold bath houses, set on a pier reaching out into the Öresund by Ribersborg beach in Malmö. It has wood-fired and electric saunas with direct access to the sea for cold bathing year-round. Separate sections for women and men.
genderPolicy: Separate sections for women and men
swimwearPolicy: Nude in the sauna, swimwear in shared areas
instructions: Drop-in - no pre-booking needed for individual visitors.
Sauna bathing is traditionally done without swimwear in the gender-separated sections.
Cold bathing directly in the Öresund from the pier, year-round.

name: Centralbadet
tagline: Art Nouveau oasis from 1904 in central Stockholm with several saunas.
description: Centralbadet is a storied Art Nouveau spa and bath house from 1904, located on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm. It has saunas, steam baths and a large indoor pool in a grand setting. NOTE: pools, saunas and gym are closed for renovation throughout 2026 - only treatments can be booked, in temporary premises at Engelbrektsgatan 5.
instructions: NOTE: pools and saunas are closed for renovation throughout 2026 - only treatments can be booked.
Book online in advance, especially on weekends.
Swimwear is required in the pool and sauna area when it reopens.

name: Hellasgården
tagline: Wood-fired sauna by Källtorpssjön with an ice hole in winter.
description: Hellasgården is a classic outdoor recreation area just east of Stockholm. The sauna sits right by the lake Källtorpssjön, so you can alternate between the heat and a dip in the lake year-round - including an ice hole in winter. All sauna visits are now pre-booked online; no drop-ins are accepted.
instructions: Pre-book online - no drop-ins are accepted.
Bring your own towel and swimwear.
Dip in lake Källtorpssjön right outside the sauna, with an ice hole in winter.
Private rental of the sauna is booked by email to info@hellasgarden.se.
